g.text: - A fundamental algorithm used to find a value in a sorted
- Uses divide and conquer approach, repeatedly halving the
search space until the target value is found or search space
value that we are searching for
boundary indices that define the current
middle index, used to decide whether to continue
searching in the left or right half of the collection
Position of an element in the collection
mid ← (left + right) / 2 // Find the middle index
left ← mid + 1 // Search in the right half
right ← mid - 1 // Search in the left half
